meta.models: SiT-B/2, batch 64, SD-VAE (ft-mse latents), ImageNet-1k 256px, 400K steps, REPA depth 8, proj coeff 0.5 (0 for unaligned); checkpoints outputs/in1k_<tag>/checkpoints/0N00000.pt (EMA)

target_names.LAP-L: per-batch least-squares affine residual on the patchified clean latent (target_mode residual)

meta.metric: Inception FID-10K and sFID/IS/precision/recall from the ADM evaluator against the ImageNet-256 reference batch (same reference and code as the paper FID-50K). Samples: generate.py, SDE Euler-Maruyama 250 steps, no CFG, global seed 0, batch 64, 1 GPU, EMA weights.
meta.step_400000: first 10,000 samples of the existing 50K sample file of the 400K checkpoint (no resampling). generate.py draws noise/labels batch by batch from one seeded stream, so these are exactly the samples a 10K run of that checkpoint would draw on the same GPU model.
meta.steps_100000_300000: fresh 10K samples, gen50k.sbatch NS=10000 with the same seed/batch. On the same GPU model the noise (z, labels, SDE noise) equals that of the 400K draw for every sample; across GPU models torch's CUDA RNG launch grid differs (SM count), so only the first batch positions of every 64 share noise: 0-53 between A100 and H100 (verified on PNGs 2026-09-23), 0-39 between a V100 and either. Per point: gpu, gpu_400k_draw, noise_shared_with_400k.
meta.fid50k_400k: results/adm_<tag>.json (original draw). NOTE: the paper uses a fresh re-evaluation draw for the three base DINOv2 rows (raw/LAP-L/LAP-N: 41.75/41.47/42.11), so paper DINOv2 FID-50K values differ from fid50k_400k here by 0.1-0.4.
